program.name: Twenty Tabata Plus
program.subject: Busy week
program.blurb: Twenty minutes: a short strength block, then a Tabata to finish, upper and lower days.
program.about: Strength and sweat in twenty minutes. A short straight-set block for the upper or lower body comes first, then a Tabata, twenty seconds hard and ten seconds rest, eight times. The new strength moves rotate in from the muscle-focus pools. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
